propositions: Design and implement an immutable OperationSnapshot type with versioned canonical serialization that captures validated non-secret effective configuration values, explicit source-kind provenance, and selected repository root without exposing secrets, live clients, or subprocess environments.

Establish central composition logic in shadow mode that applies explicit precedence (operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default) across CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points without altering current execution or stored formats.

Repository root selection follows independent precedence (explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT env > Git top-level/cwd) and relative paths resolve against the selected root; composition is deterministic and byte-stable across identical inputs.

All secret sentinels and live capability objects are excluded from snapshot fields, serialization, fingerprinting, diagnostics, schemas, and exception messages; malformed selected config raises typed errors before lock/network/write effects occur.

Shadow composition failures outside config validation are caught at the integration boundary, emit redacted warnings with no input values or paths exposed, and leave authoritative operation output and effects unchanged; rollback via REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW environment variable disabled by default in future slice.

Representative ordinary ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations through CLI, Python, MCP, and direct reconciler are exercised to verify consistent snapshot/fingerprint production and immutability under post-capture environment/file/cwd mutations.
